messages:
mike.k: Heads up, kicking off the role-seed backfill on prod now. ETA ~10m. Please avoid role/migration deploys until I confirm it's done.
anya: Got it — which PR/script are you running? link: github.com/redwood/infra/pulls/492
mike.k: Running scripts/role_seed/seed_default_roles.py with --apply. Not a `rails db:migrate`, a targeted backfill that sets NULL role -> default. I flipped dry-run off for canary earlier and it looked fine.
sarah: Quick question: what is the default value? viewer?
mike.k: target default = 'viewer' for users, org_default = 'member' for org rows. HOWEVER: noticed a join condition bug that can set org_default='owner' if org_admins is empty (my bad).
cleo: oh no. did it run on prod already?
mike.k: it started on prod ~2m ago. deploy-bot: role-seed-job started by mike.k (job id r-seed-2026-03-20-01).
james: I can see audit events in events-db: 17 user.role updates at 1775009999..1775010035. Several orgs had owner assigned where they shouldn't. I'm pausing the worker queue to stop further changes.
anya: @sarah @cleo @james tagging sec-ops: this looks like a privilege escalation risk if owners were provisioned incorrectly. Incident-bot: created incident INC-2026-0319-roles (severity: medium).
sarah: Steps: 1) Stop any running backfills 2) Dump affected user/org ids 3) Rollback incorrect role assignments 4) Rotate KMS signing key for role-change events if we suspect replay for audits 5) Notify legal/compliance if any external audits could be impacted.
cleo: I can run a selective rollback SQL once we have the list. Can someone produce the exact predicate that caused owner to be assigned?
mike.k: The problematic snippet was an outer join with COALESCE on aggregated admin flag. Here's the simplified failing logic:
```sql
UPDATE org_members om
SET role = COALESCE(om.role, COALESCE(oa.derived_role, 'member'))
FROM (
  SELECT org_id, bool_or(is_admin) as has_admin, CASE WHEN NOT bool_or(is_admin) THEN 'owner' ELSE NULL END as derived_role
  FROM org_admins
  GROUP BY org_id
) oa
WHERE om.org_id = oa.org_id AND om.role IS NULL;
```
mike.k: The derived_role should have been NULL or 'member', not 'owner'. I mis-inverted the CASE.
james: Good catch. For rollback: we should identify rows updated by job id r-seed-2026-03-20-01 using audit_log.events where meta->'job_id' = 'r-seed-2026-03-20-01'. Then revert role to previous_role stored in audit payload.
cleo: I'll write the revert script. Prefer to restore from audit instead of a blanket set to viewer.
anya: Security note: rotate the KMS key used to sign the audit events? james suggested rotating KMS if we think event integrity might be affected. Is that necessary?
sarah: If only an internal bug caused incorrect assignments and there's no sign of exfil or malicious use, rotate isn't strictly required. But we should: a) add an immutable flag to those audit entries, b) snapshot the audit table, c) keep the old key but mark events as redacted? Let's not over-rotate keys unless we have evidence.
james: Agree. I'll snapshot events-db and export affected audit rows to S3 with high-retention. Also enable a dedicated monitor to detect owner count spikes.
mike.k: I re-ran a dry-run on a snapshot and fixed the CASE. New plan: revert the 17 rows using audit->previous_value, then re-run seed with fixed logic on canary only.
cleo: Revert SQL ready, running in dry-run:
```sql
-- pseudo
SELECT id, previous_role FROM audit_log.events WHERE meta->>'job_id' = 'r-seed-2026-03-20-01';
-- then
UPDATE users u SET role = a.previous_role FROM ( ... ) a WHERE u.id = a.id;
```
cleo: dry-run shows 17 rows would be restored to their previous roles. If green, I'll run it in prod once sec sign-off.
anya: I'm opening a short postmortem doc in confluence and adding timeline. Also add a note to the oncall runbook to avoid running seed jobs during business hours without an approver.
sarah: Also: add a test for derived_role inversion and add a safety check in the backfill job to abort if it would increase owner count by >0 in any org.
james: I'll add a guard and a metric alert. Once revert completes, let's verify console permissions and run a canary of critical paths.
mike.k: Apologies for the outage. Lesson learned. I'll wait for sec sign-off before anything else. :bow:
incident-bot: INC-2026-0319-roles status updated -> mitigated."
